name: Experiment I native fixed-parameter independent confirmation

primary.unit: independent dataset mean over 40 paired sketches
primary.test: two-sided paired Student t; Holm adjustment across 18 comparisons
primary.intervals: pointwise t39 for curves; Bonferroni simultaneous t39 across 18 primary contrasts

estimators: M-driven dual recurrence or fixed-grid RK4 numerical integration; coefficient X.T u. Ridge is a labelled SPD direct-solve benchmark. No residual event stopping. Full target, tangents and probabilities recomputed at the same frozen parameters.
parameter_construction: alpha=c*trace(H)/n. Start L=max norm_i^2/pi_i over UNI,NORM,LEV. Compute all six full native targets and fixed-parameter tangents; form uniform-floor constrained OPT. If any iterative method atom exceeds L, enlarge to max(2L,1.01*required) and recompute all targets/tangents/OPT. After eight unsuccessful trials fall back to universal p/epsilon*maxnorm bound. Ridge is excluded from iterative stability bound. All construction precedes sketch uniform generation and is held fixed in perturbations. L, alpha, step counts, times and probabilities shared across all rules and budgets within a method.
discrete: LW and Nesterov h=.9/L. k_LW=ceil(1/(alpha*h)); Nesterov omega=1 and k=max(1,ceil((-3+sqrt(1+24/(alpha*h)))/2)). Every recurrence update executed.
continuous: Showalter T=1/alpha, RK4 max dt=.9/L. HBF eta=2sqrt(alpha), T=z/eta with z-1+exp(-z)=4, RK4 max dt=.2/max(sqrt(L),eta). SOAR s=.5,T=sqrt(6/alpha), transformed w=t*u with w_second+M*w=t*y, RK4 max dt=.2/sqrt(L), u(T)=w(T)/T. Actual finite-grid estimator is the primary target; ideal continuous flows are distinguished and checked by grid refinement on predesignated configurations.
probabilities: UNI uniform; NORM .99*normalized_squared_column_norm+.01/p and LEV .99*normalized_direct_SPD_solve_leverage+.01/p in primary arm. Replace .01 by arm floor in robustness. OPT exactly minimizes centered coefficient influence covariance trace subject to pi>=epsilon/p. Scores sqrt(J_i.T H J_i); derivative holds all full-data calibrated parameters fixed.
sampling: inverse probability weighted replacement with common uniforms paired across rules/methods and prefix budgets not required. Independent SeedSequence[data seed,id]; independent sampling SeedSequence[sampling seed,id,budget,arm stream]. Robustness shares full input base draws but uses independent sampling streams; not pooled with main.
outcomes: absolute and relative full-target coefficient squared gap
relative in-design noise-free signal squared risk
relative population signal risk with covariance D^2/n
full residual norm as diagnostic only
zero_and_failures: Keep every record. Zero target relative gap remains NaN; absolute gap and true risks retained. No execution cap is applied to the predetermined finite horizon; every requested step is executed. Nonfinite outputs marked numerical_failure and never excluded for a success-only mean. Zero-response arm is a deterministic boundary check, not a generated regression sample.
boundaries: Predetermined design after pilot only; no formal-data ranking used for tuning. Only Experiment I newly executed. Old DP 62/65 and 4985 caps, old five-data 65/65 and fixed-native-coordinate 65/65 remain distinct. First-order OPT is an oracle benchmark, not universal finite-budget/risk optimality or end-to-end speedup. No spectra, SVD, matrix powers or exponentials generate estimates/tangents/probabilities.
pilot: pilot_02 passed 65 checks before formal generation; pilot_01 stopped for unnecessary Ridge contribution to iterative bound, retained with source snapshot.
